atoms.text: Floods are the most common natural disaster in the United Kingdom. Floods have different causes. Sometimes, floods are caused by very heavy rain. Usually this happens during heavy storms. Other times, floods happen when snow melts very quickly in winter or spring. Floods also have many different effects. They can knock down trees and cause people to lose electricity. They can even push an entire house away.

b: ++an overflow of water onto land that is usually dry
a large eruption that damages buildings and landscapes

atoms.text: Floods can be very dangerous. There are systems in place in the United Kingdom to warn people about floods. Sometimes, experts can guess when a flood is going to happen, and they warn everyone who might be in danger. Then, people have time to move to higher ground where the flood waters won’t reach them.

atoms.a: What happens when experts think a flood is going to happen?

b.sound: they warn everyone who might be in danger
they tell people to stay where they are
